 Responsibilities
 Perform manual and automated testing across Windows and macOS environments.
 Investigate complex defects by analyzing logs, validating system states, and working directly with the Windows Registry and macOS-specific configuration files.
 Configure, use, and troubleshoot virtual machines (VMs) to ensure cross-platform compatibility.
 Collaborate closely with development and product teams to clarify requirements and define acceptance criteria.
 Track, document, and report defects using Jira or similar issue-tracking tools.
 Adapt quickly to changing sprint and business priorities, shifting focus to critical deliverables while maintaining quality.
 Design, develop, and maintain test automation frameworks, preferably using Python, with Java or other object oriented languages also accepted.
 Develop and maintain automated tests for desktop and/or web applications.
 Qualifications
 Minimum 4–5 years of QA experience, with strong experience in desktop application testing on Windows/macOS and/or web testing.
 Strong hands-on experience in test automation and writing automation code.
 Python experience is a significant advantage; strong experience with Java or other object-oriented programming languages is also relevant.
 Strong familiarity with configuring, using, and troubleshooting virtual machines.
 Practical experience with Jira or similar defect-tracking tools.
 Good knowledge of file systems, Windows Registry, and macOS configuration structures.
 Strong debugging, log analysis, and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and technical environments.
 Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn new technologies quickly.
 Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking.
